create_dqn_agent: create a DQNAgent instance with num_actions, observation_size, and num_players for multiplayer Hanabi
build_dqn_network: build a DQN neural network mapping states to Q-values using dqn_template with configurable layers
run_training_step: run a training step that updates the replay buffer and syncs online to target network weights
select_action_epsilon_greedy: select an action using epsilon-greedy policy with linearly decaying exploration rate
checkpoint_agent_state: checkpoint and bundle the DQNAgent TensorFlow weights and Python state for later restoration
